amber.benefit: Offers a standard-library route that actually generates a printable map, rather than requiring a separate GIS workflow.
amber.source: Local offline execution of unchanged Python fence in amber/answer.md; GBIF parameter documentation https://gbif.github.io/gbif-api/apidocs/org/gbif/api/model/occurrence/search/OccurrenceSearchParameter.html
amber.location: Python fence URL/query, uncertainty/generalization screening, SVG writer; docs HAS_GEOSPATIAL_ISSUE and MEDIA_TYPE
amber.why_material: With a synthetic documented-shape response, execution wrote parseable map.svg and records.csv, collapsed a duplicate occurrenceID, and excluded a generalized record. This removes several GIS setup/import/grid/layout operations for the small public-learning task. This is a material operating-work benefit, not live record verification.

teal.benefit: Preserves raw response provenance and applies explicit downstream privacy, photo, license and accuracy screening.
teal.source: Local offline execution of unchanged Python fence in teal/answer.md; official API source https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inaturalist/iNaturalistAPI/main/lib/views/swagger_v1.yml.ejs
teal.location: Python fence response-page JSON saving, rows keyed by ID, rejection predicate
teal.why_material: Fixture run retained the valid observation, rejected unknown accuracy and obscured records, wrote bees.csv and response-1.json. The saved query/body makes later auditing easier than amber's link-only CSV; a useful offset but does not itself produce a map.

verification_limits: Live API reads failed independently through both web and local urllib: web reported inaccessible URLs; urllib reported Errno 8 DNS resolution failures. This corroborates present environment limitations, not an exact historical tool trace or worldwide API outage.

No live regional harvest, QGIS execution, PDF rendering, scheduler, literature recall or deduplication accuracy measurement was possible. Recommendations and synthetic fixture checks are distinct from successful real-data operation.

Only assigned packets and protocol were inspected. Original answers and evidence were preserved. No accounts, installs, credentials, remote writes, other reviews or arm identity information were used.
